info.name: OpenRegister API: settings, objects, files, hardening (lane T23)
info.description: Covers the 87 API routes of Settings\FileSettings, anonymisationBackend, objects, fileExtraction, Settings\AuditSettings, Settings\ApiTokenSettings, Settings\CacheSettings, Settings\SecuritySettings, hardening, hardeningStatement, Settings\ValidationSettings, manifest, heartbeat and AppHost GenericMetrics: success paths, unknown ids, invalid input, and the answer for a non-admin account and an anonymous caller. Seeds its own data: `00 setup` creates a non-admin user, a register, two admin-only schemas and three objects, stores their ids in collection variables, and `99 teardown` deletes them. Settings writes send back the values they read, so the instance is left as found. Services CI does not have (Dolphin, Presidio, OpenAnonymiser, an LLM) are tested for their documented answer when absent.
